content: The solution of the problem in Eq. EQREF45 is of the form INLINEFORM0 , where INLINEFORM1 is a constant. The algorithm searches the value of this constant (which is similar to INLINEFORM2 in our problem), which lies in a particular interval of split-points (line SECREF38 ), iteratively shrinking this interval. The algorithm requires computing medians as a subroutine, which can be done in linear time BIBREF24 . The overall complexity in INLINEFORM3 BIBREF16 . The same algorithm has been used in NLP by BIBREF23 for a budgeted summarization problem.
